title: Steel isolation (tfmg)
description: Industrial Steel: TFMG machinery now requires only heavy industrial steel.(Recipe separation has been implemented between TFMG and other mods.)
body:
EN: **_Heavy Industrial Steel_:** Isolating TFMG machinery crafts for better balance.Recipe separation has been implemented between TFMG and other mods.

RU: **_Сплавы и заводы_:** Этот датапак защищает сложные крафты TFMG от дешевой стали.Разделение рецептов стали между TFMG и другими модами
